nom: St. Ives Avocado & Honey Face Scrub

avis.texte: This is my favorite face wash/scrub. It gently exfoliates & leaves my skin soft. Plus, it doesn't cost an arm & a leg.

avis.titre: Like the smell, like the mid-level exfoliants. Would def buy again.
avis.texte: I like this. Ordered this because I did not like the smell of a generic option I had tried from another store. And another I tried had almost 0 exfoliant in it. This smells nice and has a nice feel; not too harsh but enough exfoliant to feel clean. I will definitely buy this again.
For the price this is a great face cleaner Works well with just water. I will definitely purchase again
Been using this scrub for years and it gently removes skin flakes with no issues. Not harsh like some other scrubs.

avis.titre: Be sure to get the St. Ives scrub recommended for your skin type/needs.
avis.texte: I am enjoying using the St. Ives Avocado & Honey Face Scrub. I chose it based on my skin type and it is great. I do recommend it.
